Name: Produce to Sapling - Mae's Trees for PFM
Author: metalax
Description:
Uses the Producer Framework Mod to permit tree produce to be processed into saplings at the seed maker.

One additional sapling is given for each quality level.

Regular: 1
Silver: 2
Gold: 3
Iridium: 4

This mod covers all tree produce from the 'Mae's Trees' mod.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]Mae's Trees[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][PFM] Produce to Sapling - Mae's Trees[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac.
[*] Due to PFM only permitting one rule for each combo of input and machine, this will not be compatible with other PFM mods that add interactions with the seed maker for 'Mae's Trees' tree produce. A compatibility patch will be required. Drop a post with a link to the other mod and I'll see about making a compatibility patch.
[/list]
